name: free-llm-router
description: 앱 안에서 무료 LLM 제공처를 폴백하며 호출하는 라우터 (React Native, 순수 TypeScript)

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:test
scripts.conformance: npm run build && npm run build:test && node build/__tests__/run-conformance.js
scripts.test:slow: npm run build && npm run build:test && FLR_SLOW=1 node --test --test-reporter=spec build/__tests__/conformance.test.js
scripts.test:live: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=spec build/__tests__/live-smoke.test.js
